sentences: One of the key guidelines we follow is to always start variable names with 'm_'.
This is to ensure consistency and to easily identify our variables in the code.
Remember to implement this from now on.
I want to emphasize the importance of code consistency and clarity within our team.
Going forward, I need you to ensure that all your variable names start with 'z_'.
This is to maintain a clear distinction from other variables in the codebase and to avoid potential naming conflicts.
We have a rigorous code review process, and I want you to focus on writing clean code from the start, without relying on pre-commit hooks as a crutch.
Don't hesitate to utilize multithreading or asynchronous programming if it helps improve the overall throughput.
Remember to keep the UI concise and focused on the essential functionality.
We don't want to overwhelm our users with unnecessary complexity.
Remember, simplicity and performance are key.
Don't hesitate to reach out if any issues arise.
Keep in mind, the activities should be inclusive and cater to different comfort levels and abilities.
Also, don't forget to set a budget and work within it.
